reason: Using n=3 solver samples per task is acceptable for a bounded coarse one-step consequence screen once the meaningful-effect margin is widened to a preregistered +/-5 percentage points. Reference tool-call grading is independent outcome truth, skill_mode=False isolates generated-task difficulty, and split/merge arms reuse identical task/solver outcomes. The full confirmatory heldout utility margin remains 2pp and is not changed by this P0-C design.
